notes.title: NEW SLOT GAME UPDATE !!!
notes.content:
The highly requested slot game, Sweet Witch, has been added.
Bet limits on slot games have been removed.
Several minor bugs have been fixed.


https://i.imgur.com/0vMW4Fb.jpeg

notes.title: Optimization & Bug Fix
notes.content:
- Added FPS limit setting for optimization. Default is 60.
- Fixed the issue where cargo boxes would disappear, preventing interaction with other objects.
- Removed the starting balance of -$400.
